formRaceEntries.comment: Did it tough when racing wide at Ararat after a run of steady efforts. Down in class & worth thought here.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF, Visors OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Covered ground at Wodonga but had been in consistent form previously. Worth another chance.
Gave too much start at Ararat & gave too much start at Mildura. Down in class & extra tip suits.
Raced tight and should have finished closer off a six-week break at Wodonga. Place hope from the draw.
Looks to need it a bit easier.
formRaceEntries.gearChanges: Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Tongue Control and Lugging Bit FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME

formRaceEntries.comment: At the rear both runs this campaign. Must lift.
Ran on soundly when resuming over 1500m at Mornington. Fitter for that & a little more ground suits.
Resumes. Placed two of four first-up & 5th/6 in a Traralgon hurdle trial 20/5. Watch the market.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF, Winkers OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Fair effort in an on-pacers' race at Mildura last time. Back in trip for this but doesn't want it too wet.
Has been ok at last couple of runs and is in with a place chance.
Mixing form of late, ok at Wangaratta only to prove disappointing last time. Best taken on trust.
Well beaten at Werribee first-up. Fitter for that & down in class for this.
Slow out & found traffic when not disgraced here second-up. Fitter & races OK over this trip.
Well held when resuming, eased down and vetted second up, hanging out badly at Kilmore. Needs to lift.
